Its practical importance is that it survives an fvol refusal, which COVERAGE and ladder_position do not. [E1D2] THE DAY-2 INDICTMENT. The term measures room INSIDE the phase range on the trade side, so an entry AT a fresh extreme has zero room by construction: it refuses every continuation/breakout entry and accepts only trades pointed back across the range. On an EXPANDED day (S2 day_type_so_far, 112.1% of range_hat) it appears in the refusal set of 24 of 38 winners; SI-20210702-051810-L (ext_needed $512.5) paid +$1,707.50 and SI-20210702-052297-L (ext $537.5) paid +$1,682.50. But the day WINNERS (HG TOKYO longs) needed ext_needed $450-612 of NEW range. New-range longs won, new-range shorts walled, in-range shorts made small money, all on one session: the term is not measuring capacity, it is proxying which side of the session own trend the trade points. [E1D4] As term T6 (ext_needed <= $450) it passes only 21 of the day's 136 winners (their median ext_needed is $750 and their max $1,008) and it sole-blocked 9 rows worth +$1,075.56 with 3 winners. Its threshold was chosen by the criterion ERA_NOTES §41 strikes.
